newsitem.title: THAILAND: Ailing Bangkok BoC capital to be reduced.
newsitem.headline: Ailing Bangkok BoC capital to be reduced.

text.p: Thai authorities have decided to reduced ailing Bangkok Bank of Commerce's paid up capital to 15 billion baht from the current 35.5 billion baht, finance officials said on Saturday.

Proceeds from the capital reduction would be used to reduce part of the bank's bad and doubtful debts estimated now at 50 billion baht. Loan loss provisions of another two billion baht would also be used for the same purpose, they added.

The Bank of Thailand, which has a majority stake in the troubled bank through one of its funds, would run the bank with the aim of turning it around in eight years' time, a central bank official said.
The BOT would buy the rest of the bank's bad debts at a discounted value. Payment would be in the form of eight-year bills of exchange at coupon of 12.5 percent.
The decisions were taken at a meeting of senior finance ministry and central bank officials with Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan late on Friday.
The government had previously offered the bank for sale to interested parties but deals for the sale were never realised.
